title: FREESURFER MRIsConvert

annot_file.desc: input is annotation or gifti label data

dataarray_num.desc: if input is gifti, 'num' specifies which data array to use

functional_file.desc: input is functional time-series or other multi-frame data (must specify surface)

label_file.desc: infile is .label file, label is name of this label

labelstats_outfile.desc: outfile is name of gifti file to which label stats will be written

normal.desc: output is an ascii file where vertex data

out_datatype.desc: These file formats are supported:  ASCII:       .ascICO: .ico, .tri GEO: .geo STL: .stl VTK: .vtk GIFTI: .gii MGH surface-encoded 'volume': .mgh, .mgz

out_file.desc: output filename or True to generate one

parcstats_file.desc: infile is name of text file containing label/val pairs

patch.desc: input is a patch, not a full surface

rescale.desc: rescale vertex xyz so total area is same as group average

scalarcurv_file.desc: input is scalar curv overlay file (must still specify surface)

talairachxfm_subjid.desc: apply talairach xfm of subject to vertex xyz

to_scanner.desc: convert coordinates from native FS (tkr) coords to scanner coords

to_tkr.desc: convert coordinates from scanner coords to native FS (tkr) coords

vertex.desc: Writes out neighbors of a vertex in each row

xyz_ascii.desc: Print only surface xyz to ascii file

description: Uses Freesurfer's mris_convert to convert surface files to various formats
